title: Natural-number configuration code
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, let $x$ be a Boolean input string, and let $C$ be a configuration of $N$ on input $x$. For a natural number $s$, its code is the natural number represented by the configuration encoding word at window parameter $s$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols
A configuration $C$ of that machine on $x$
caveat: The supplied definitions do not specify the word-to-natural-number convention used to evaluate the encoding word.
